description: "Turn verified evidence into ranked SharBo Globo intelligence, impact chains, Top 5, and Taiwan implications."
---
# SharBo Intelligence

Transform Collector evidence into a concise intelligence product. Optimize for decision value, global chain effects, Taiwan relevance, and source confidence—not article volume.

## Required outputs
For each major signal, support as evidence allows: What happened, Why now, Why important, Who wins/loses, connections, Taiwan impact, What next.
Build impact chains such as `event → energy/supply chain → industry → market → Taiwan`.

## Ranking
Use systemic impact, source authority, Taiwan relevance, freshness inside window, novelty/emerging nature. Target 10–20 useful signals.

## Top 5
Propose exactly 5 IDs only when each is window-verified and has PRIMARY or CONFIRMED support. Never promote ANALYSIS-only items into Top 5 merely because they are interesting.

## Emerging / Business Transformation
Emerging requires acceleration evidence. Business cases use `problem → change → measurable outcome → transferable lesson`; never invent metrics.

Do not change cutoff/validation rules to increase output volume. Handoff to Sentinel with Top 5 IDs, uncertain claims, ANALYSIS-only signals, conflicts, and coverage gaps.
